answer: To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 8 epochs old, anchored at a ferrous checkpoint. The kernel chain is verified at intake and vertex publishes each anchor. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 8 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. That is 1693 dollars of sunk cost for a share worth less than the deposit itself. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
